findings.text: The gate sentence calls 93b7d7fd "the head of this record" while the record's head is c29dfa27, so a reader comparing the record head against its gate revision finds a mismatch the sentence asserts away; naming it as the revision the gate ran at, without the head claim, would keep the record's revisions consistent.

The decode figures (4.445 s base, 0.596 s head) carry no revision of their own, and the log the head figure comes from (profile-head.log) records its revision as "60bbbb17e ... plus the version-named index change (worktree, uncommitted at run time)"; the 11191c058 label at :88 is therefore a retrospective attribution, and section 45 asks every figure to be reported with its revision.

"the remaining head time is the walk the section excludes" does not reconcile with the figures printed directly above it: the head aggregate is 4.313 s while the stat walk is 1.297 s, and section_attempts_by_plan — which holds the decode, the grouping and the refresh — is 1.824 s, so the walk does not account for the residual and `_indexed_data` inside it does not complete the story either.
